expected_fail.name: flex/fri07_collapsed_strut_single_line
expected_fail.reason: Chrome 149.0.7827.115 places the first visible item at y=0 instead of the CSS Flexbox section 4.4 collapsed-strut requirement y=5 in all four variants; WPT flexbox_visibility-collapse.html corroborates removal; revalidate on a Chrome pin/profile change, CSS/WPT expectation change, or Chrome collapsed-flex-strut support

expected_fail.name: flex/fri07_collapsed_strut_wrapping
expected_fail.reason: Chrome 149.0.7827.115 reports root height 157 instead of the CSS Flexbox section 4.4 collapsed-strut requirement 68 in all four variants; WPT flexbox_visibility-collapse-line-wrapping.html corroborates removal and rewrapping; revalidate on a Chrome pin/profile change, CSS/WPT expectation change, or Chrome collapsed-flex-strut support

expected_fail.name: flex/fri07_flex_composition
expected_fail.reason: Chrome 149.0.7827.115 places child zero at y=6 instead of 27 in LTR and y=134 instead of 113 in RTL for both box modes after valid zero clip-box lowering; CSS Flexbox section 4.4 and WPT collapse oracles require collapsed-item removal with a retained strut; revalidate on a Chrome pin/profile change, CSS/WPT expectation change, or Chrome collapsed-flex-strut support
